children: Wrangler is extending its brand into a footwear line through licensing partner Genesco
with its Fall 2026 collection that features western-style footwear for men, women, and children.
The Wrangler footwear line launches September 15 on the company’s website, with availability at select U.S. retailers rolling out later in the season.
“We’ve combined Wrangler’s iconic heritage and deep connection with consumers with our footwear expertise to create a collection that is unmistakably Wrangler,”
Rick Higgins, president of Genesco Brands Group.
Wrangler, a primary brand of Kontoor Brands

, is riding the coattails of a fashion renaissance in Western wear thanks to the popularity of shows like Yellowstone, the proliferation of country music festivals, and brand ambassadors that include Lainey Wilson and Cody Johnson. Wrangler’s affordability (ranging from $25 to $50), improved fit, and expanded women’s line helped fuel Q2 sales and an upbeat outlook for the remainder of the year.
second quarter earnings call, CEO Scott Baxter acknowledged the strength of the brand and its growing popularity with both men and women.

“Western sits at the heart of Wrangler's DNA, and we have never been stronger. To support this momentum, we will continue to invest behind our product innovation and demand creation platforms to solidify our position as the authority in the category,” Baxter said.

title: Wrangler expands brand with new footwear line from Genesco
